about: What each sound in the pack is for. sfx_pack.py synthesizes the files, audiomap.py enforces `rules`, qa.py checks them. offset = dB under the voice's speech level.

sounds.title: Counting
sounds.about: fast ticking count: numbers counting up, text typing on (chat pills), a list filling in
sounds.usage: only a number counting up on screen

sounds.title: Glitch
sounds.about: digital glitch: glitch / RGB effects, inverts, a broken or wrong state, a hard stop
sounds.usage: only on a glitch, RGB split or invert effect; at most 3 a reel, 5 s apart

sounds.title: Cinematic Whoosh
sounds.about: cinematic whoosh: transitions, overlays and phones moving in or out, zooms, smash cuts
sounds.usage: the background sound: every transition and every phone, overlay or background moving in or out. Quiet, so it may repeat freely and may play under other sounds

sounds.title: Metallic Riser
sounds.about: metallic riser that peaks at its end: the hook build and the swell into every drop (sync on the reveal)
sounds.usage: only in the hook, once, building into the hook's payoff

sounds.title: Low Hit
sounds.about: deep low hit: drops, punch titles, the key line, shakes, a red X
sounds.usage: the big reveal (a drop) and a screen shake; at most 4 a reel, 5 s apart

sounds.title: Camera Flash
sounds.about: camera flash: white flashes, spotlights, a screen lighting up
sounds.usage: only on an on-screen white flash (fx flash); at most 2 a reel, 10 s apart

sounds.title: Camera Flash & Shutter
sounds.about: flash plus shutter: before -> after snaps, freeze frames, a screenshot
sounds.usage: only on a freeze frame / screenshot moment (fx freeze); at most 2 a reel

sounds.title: Page Flip
sounds.about: page flip: a screen changing state, swipes, cards and backgrounds sliding, flips
sounds.usage: a mockup changing state (a swap); at most 8 a reel, 2.5 s apart; other swaps stay silent

sounds.title: Shine
sounds.about: shine / sparkle: a check mark, an icon or result appearing, something done right
sounds.usage: the loud ding: only when a button is visibly clicked for the call to action (a `tap` sticker with `"cta": true`), once a reel. Never on a spoken CTA with nothing clicked on screen

sounds.title: Pop
sounds.about: pop: taps, stickers, emoji, chat bubbles, notes and small things popping in
sounds.usage: every piece of on-screen text appearing (titles, punch words, text stickers, banners, chat bubbles) gets it, always; small pop-ins (emoji, icons, check marks, taps) only when no text pop is near

sounds.title: Scribble
sounds.about: pen, pencil and marker: handwritten notes, underline and circle draws
sounds.usage: only while a hand-drawn note, circle, arrow or underline is being drawn; the file is the one whose length matches the draw

sounds.title: Key presses
sounds.usage: computer typing: one key press per letter, on the frame each letter appears (chat pills, typed titles), always. Rotates through the key files so no two in a row match
